explanation: The theorem says the determinant map from K₀(R) to Pic(R) is surjective. Both `KTheory.K0` and `determinantHom` are defined in this library. I searched Mathlib for `K0` and `KTheory` and found no algebraic K-theory of rings. The only matches were unrelated uses of the identifier in files on analysis, Cauchy sequences and class groups. So no Mathlib declaration can state this result. The proof only uses the library's own lemma `determinantHom_pic_representative`.
